page.overview:
What is Welcome Show Animatronics?

The Welcome Show animatronics are old, sessile animatronics created by Edwin Murray that first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic during the "Demo-tronic Welcome Show" sequence and throughout the game. The are all seen inside the Welcome Show room.

Some of them appear frequently in the game, not as animatronics, but rather as costumes for The Mimic to wear.

The Welcome Show animatronics are part of the Demo-tronic Welcome Show, which are colorful characters, diverse in animal species, occupation, and size. Many of them are seen performing with instruments, some with various themed objects, and others simply are decorative.

None of the animatronics display any form of sentience or awareness, as they are built to follow protocols assigned by an outside user.
